name: Hallowed Chain, Greater (Varisian)
body:
Source Inner Sea Races pg. 225
Aura moderate conjuration CL 11th
Slot armor; Price 43,300 gp; Weight 40 lbs.
Description
The following suit of armor is generally available only to members of the indicated race or ethnicity.

This armor functions as hallowed chain, except that it protects as a suit of +3 martyringUE chainmail and can absorb up to 10 points of positive energy.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, mass cure moderate wounds, creator must be a Varisian; Price 21,800 gp
